max_difficulty.why: The hardest tricks the seed may require of you.

preset.why: Sets which tricks the logic expects you to know.

energy_qty.why: Fewer Energy and Reserve Tanks leave less room for mistakes.

area_randomization.why: Areas are connected in a different order.

boss_randomization.why: Access to the Golden 4 bosses is shuffled.

escape_rando.why: Leaving Tourian drops you somewhere else, and you must find your way back to the ship.

fun_combat.why: Can remove strong beams such as Plasma and Screw Attack.

fun_movement.why: Can remove movement items such as Space Jump or Speed Booster.

fun_suits.why: Can remove the Varia or Gravity Suit.

nerfed_charge.why: The starting Charge Beam does a third of its damage.

gravity_behaviour.why: Vanilla gives the Gravity Suit full protection; progressive changes how much each suit protects on its own, which is a judgement call.

morph_placement.why: With normal placement the Morphing Ball can turn up later.

tourian.why: A faster Tourian skips Metroids and other obstacles.

death_link.why: When someone else dies, you die; Enable Survive lets a reserve tank save you.

accessibility.why: Minimal accessibility only promises the goal can be finished.
